audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] read LeBlanc x6 + Ekko — the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways.
audit.why: 52.13% over 1903 games supports a mild LeBlanc lane edge with the flip at two items, exactly what the content layer already says. Ekko's Phase Dive is 325 range and Parallel Convergence takes seconds to form, so a ranged sigil-and-chain pattern owns the early rows.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side -> LeBlanc at 6/10, phases[6].side -> Ekko at 4/10, with phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said Chronobreak 'doesn't stop your burst from landing first' and mid text called it 'pre-charged'.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110/80/50 and carries the untargetable flag — he cannot be hit at all while it resolves, and he heals a percentage of the damage received during the rewind window. It is not charged; it is cast, and the cast is what wastes your commit.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike and mid text re-keyed to the untargetable window and the 110s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shield was credited to Ekko's passive, LeBlanc's dash was called 'E', and Phase Dive's auto-reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Z-Drive Resonance is the every-third-hit bonus plus a speed burst; the shield and the stun both belong to Parallel Convergence (22/20/18/16/14) and only trigger if Ekko himself enters his anomaly. Phase Dive carries the autoReset flag — the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell. LeBlanc's dash is Distortion (W). Timewinder also damages on its return pass, so the safe entry is after the grenade has rewound, not before.
audit.corrected: Shield attributed to Parallel Convergence, dash named as W, Phase Dive's reset stated as the step-back cue, Timewinder's return pass used to time the entry.

audit.why: Chronobreak 110s->50s, Parallel Convergence 22s->14s, Timewinder 9s->7s are the numbers the advice needs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite the brief flagging it.
audit.why: Chronobreak heals for a percentage of the damage received during the rewind, so unmitigated it refunds the trade you just won.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb added to the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d duplicated tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d duplicated tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d was a name-swappable template.
audit.why: Lint findings plus the template sweep.
audit.corrected: All three replaced with bodies grounded in Phase Dive, Z-Drive Resonance and Chronobreak.

edits.before: Late LeBlanc picks: W the flank, chain the carry, mimic the exit — and vanish before the obituary prints.
edits.after: Two items in, Chronobreak drops to 50s and his sustain lets him live the rotation and come back.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3 — he is untargetable through it, so hold your last spell until he lands. - Parallel Convergence is 22s at rank 1 and only stuns if he steps into his own anomaly. - Your own W is 15s at rank 1: the return is for the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Ekko wins by baiting your burst into an untargetable Chronobreak and retaking the fight with the health it refunds.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — chain Ekko away from his Parallel Convergence anomaly, where his shield and his stun both live.

edits.before: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Untargetable while he rewinds — a mimic spent into Chronobreak is simply deleted. Commit on its 110s cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: Phase Dive is an auto reset that teleports him onto you — the wind-up is your cue to chain, not the cast.

edits.before: That is Ekko’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Phase Dive is 325 range on a 9s cooldown — inside it he resets an auto onto you for free.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Z-Drive Resonance procs on every third hit and Chronobreak refunds the damage he took — long duels are his.

edits.before: Track Ekko’s Chronobreak: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3, and he is untargetable while it resolves — hold your last spell until the rewind lands and he is standing again.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Stormsurge or Luden's, Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Spend gold like the lead expires — it does.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Stormsurge or Luden's, Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Oblivion Orb cuts the Chronobreak heal.

edits.before: No escape on his early kit means every Q-throw window is a free trade for your dash
edits.after: At 1 he has only Timewinder on 9s and no Phase Dive yet, so the throw window is free

edits.before: Same through level 5 — his passive shield doesn't offset his lack of disengage
edits.after: Same at 2 — the shield is on Parallel Convergence and needs him to walk into it

edits.before: Ultimate combo kills him outright if he hasn't pre-charged his rewind escape
edits.after: Your full string kills him outright as long as Chronobreak is still on cooldown

edits.before: Ekko's Timewinder (Q) has a long cooldown and no real disengage before he has W stacked — dash in with E right after he throws it and you get a clean, safe trade.
edits.after: Timewinder is 9s at rank 1 and damages again on its return pass, so W in after the grenade has rewound past you — then leave before his anomaly forms.

edits.before: His ultimate (Chronobreak) is a delayed-rewind escape/heal, but it doesn't stop your burst from landing first — R-E-Q-W still kills him if he doesn't have it up as a get-out-of-jail card.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 and makes him untargetable while it resolves — your full string kills him outright when it is down, and is thrown away entirely when it is not, so check it before you open.

edits.before: Ekko's Timewinder has real recovery time and no built-in escape, so the instant he throws it at you or misses it, dash in with E for a totally uncontested trade — his passive shield only matters if he lands his own combo first, which he can't do without you letting him. Look for all-ins from level 3 onward whenever his Q is down; without it he has no way to zone or disengage from your dash.
edits.after: Ekko's Timewinder is 9s at rank 1 and comes back through you on the return pass, so W in once the grenade has already rewound past you and the trade is uncontested — his shield sits on Parallel Convergence and only exists if he walks into his own anomaly. Look for all-ins from level 3 whenever Timewinder is down; Phase Dive is only 325 range, so it closes gaps but never escapes yours.

edits.before: At 6 he gets Chronobreak, a delayed rewind that heals and repositions him — but it's not instant, so your burst combo (R-E-Q-W) still kills him if he doesn't have the ultimate pre-charged as an escape valve. Keep applying pressure and denying his farm; a starved Ekko has no way to reach the Riftmaker timing he needs to become a threat. Roam off any lane lead since he has no wave-clear tool to punish your movement.
edits.after: At 6 he gets Chronobreak, a 110s rewind that heals a share of the damage he just took — and he is untargetable while it resolves, so a last spell thrown into it is simply gone. Keep applying pressure and denying his farm; a starved Ekko never reaches the Riftmaker timing he needs to become a threat. Roam off any lane lead since he has no wave-clear tool to punish your movement.

edits.after: Punish every Timewinder throw with an immediate W in
